purpose: Post-hoc explanation of paired neural/physical allocation and packet-delay differences; no policy or model selection
native_comparison: all measured UE slots and allocations
resource occupancy and service breadth/batch size
identical-arrival packet matching, including common successes
same_state_replay: Both solvers on every measured saved state from both trajectories; additionally the common first post-warmup state at TTI2001 once per seed; no state selected by outcomes
block_audit: Every graph block from frozen neural incumbent on neural-origin TTI4001 and TTI10001, for each seed; compare neural complete candidates and physical intermediate/final candidates under the same floor/physical/objective guards; trace pruning of the best physical candidate
physical_continuation: The same six neural-origin states, original draft floor, physical search warm-started at the neural result; diagnostic extra computation, not a matched-budget policy comparison
aggregation: Seed is the independent replicate; report paired seed differences; saved states, UEs and packets are descriptive repeated observations
boundaries: Different native trajectories share exogenous channels/traffic but not queue/EMA/MCS states after divergence
Replay holds all pre-action inputs fixed and measures one-step predicted consequences only
No new native rollout or latency causal mediation claim
MCS is supplied in the saved Problem, not independently chosen by the repair decoder
